title: Professional Certificate Course in E-procurement in Project management
description: Understand e-procurement in project management to enhance skills in electronic purchasing processes.
longDescription: This professional certificate course in E-procurement in Project Management offers comprehensive training on the different aspects of electronic purchasing processes. The course covers topics such as category management and its process, the concept of Public Services Network and procure-to-pay, and the meaning of ERP, E-Sourcing, E-tendering, and P-card. Participants will gain knowledge on the instruments of procurement and their practical application in project management. By the end of the course, participants will have developed the necessary skills to effectively implement e-procurement processes in their respective organizations.
